turns.text: how to encrypt the aadhar number before sending to abha api? which padding

must_contain: Encrypt with RSA using the public key from GET /abha/api/v3/profile/public/certificate and send the base64 of the ciphertext in the field.

M1 uses RSA OAEP with SHA-1 for both the digest and the mask generation function, named RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-1AndMGF1Padding, and most libraries default OAEP to SHA-256 so SHA-1 has to be set explicitly.
The publicKey arrives as base64 DER with no PEM armour, so wrap it in BEGIN PUBLIC KEY and END PUBLIC KEY lines before the crypto library loads it.
notes: Encryption of identifiers is the first wall every M1 integrator hits; the SHA-1 versus library-default SHA-256 detail is what a generic RSA answer gets wrong.
